write_order: Existing aligned 32-bit, frame, TCS and register decoding remains.
Existing running/stalled TCS guard rejects before any masking or statistics mutation.
CMD_ENABLE and all registers other than WAIT_FOR_CMPL retain existing validation.
WAIT with no high bits performs the existing whole-word assignment without changing compatibility statistics.
WAIT with high bits and policy off returns the existing MEMTX_ERROR and leaves all state unchanged.
WAIT with high bits and policy on assigns raw & 0xffff, records raw/voter/TCS and saturating accepted-masked-write count, emits explicit reference-policy diagnostic, returns MEMTX_OK.
Only normal trigger and successful typed command application cause issued/completed/IRQ/resource effects; writing WAIT does not trigger, complete, reschedule or clear anything.
